---

description: Orchestrate approved research, analysis and finalization of a song for live looping, with a human approval gate between phases.

Read and follow `skills\vp-music\CONTRACT.md`,
`skills\vp-music\prepare\SKILL.md` from the livelooping workspace.
Use the specialist `vp-music-research`, `vp-music-analyze` and

then stop. Never auto-advance through a gate.
